full_prompt_en: A simple hand-colored newspaper comic panel shows a solemn child standing on the left and a smiling white dog on the right. The child has a large round head, one curled line of hair on the forehead, sparse dot eyes, and a small downturned mouth. A bright yellow shirt with a thick black zigzag band, dark shorts, and brown shoes make a compact, instantly readable silhouette. The dog stands upright holding a small bowl, its long rounded nose pointing toward the child and one black ear giving the white body a clear side accent. Both figures rest on a flat ochre-yellow floor before an empty rusty-brown wall. A thin straight line marks the wall-floor join, and no furniture or scenery competes with the exchange between the two. Black ink contour varies slightly in thickness around cheeks, ears, clothing edges, and feet. Tiny scratchy strokes gather inside the dark shorts and ear, while the skin, shirt, dog, wall, and floor are filled with broad nearly flat color. The pigment has mild mottling and warm paper grain, keeping the surface softly printed rather than glossy. Light is even and undramatic, with only short gray shadows beneath the feet. The figures occupy the lower two-thirds, leaving open brown space above their heads. Their opposing eye lines and contrasting expressions provide the humor: the dog's relaxed smile meets the child's worried stillness. The panel is restrained, warm, and expressive through a few carefully placed lines rather than detailed modeling.
full_prompt_zh: 一格简洁手工上色的报刊漫画呈现左侧站着的严肃孩子和右侧微笑白狗。孩子有大圆头、额上一道卷发线、稀少点眼和小小下垂嘴。明黄色衬衫带粗黑锯齿纹，配暗短裤和棕鞋，形成紧凑而一眼可读的剪影。小狗直立拿着小碗，长而圆的鼻子朝向孩子，一只黑耳成为白身体清晰的侧面强调。两人都站在平坦赭黄色地面上，身后是空荡的锈棕墙。细直线指出墙地交界，没有家具或景物争夺两者之间的交流。黑墨轮廓在脸颊、耳、衣边和脚周围轻微变粗变细。暗短裤和狗耳内聚着细小抓纸笔痕，皮肤、衣服、狗、墙与地面则以宽阔近乎平面的颜色填充。颜料轻微斑驳，暖纸粒让表面有柔软印刷感而非亮滑。光均匀且不戏剧化，只有脚下短灰影。人物占据下方三分之二，上方留有开放棕色空间。相对视线与相反表情提供幽默：狗放松的微笑遇上孩子忧虑的静止。画格克制而温暖，靠几条谨慎安排的线表达情绪，不靠复杂塑形。
style_prompt_en: Simple hand-colored newspaper-comic art uses economical black ink contour and broad nearly flat color areas on subtly grainy warm paper. A rusty-brown upper field and ochre-yellow lower band establish the largest color relationship, with one vivid yellow accent and concentrated black shapes. Rounded silhouettes and a few small curved marks carry expression; line weight changes slightly rather than staying mechanically uniform. Tiny scratchy fills collect in dark areas, but most surfaces remain open and unmodeled. A single low horizontal division supports a compact pair of shapes, leaving a broad quiet field above. Even light creates only small grounding shadows, so the image reads through contour, spacing, and color rather than dramatic volume. Mild pigment mottling and imperfect ink edges preserve the physical printed feel. The arrangement is direct and humorous, with clear negative space between the main shapes and an easy left-to-right conversational rhythm. Every visible detail earns its place in the panel's simple visual grammar.
style_prompt_zh: 简洁手工上色的报刊漫画以经济的黑墨轮廓和宽阔近乎平面的色面落在带微细颗粒的暖纸上。锈棕上部色场与赭黄下部色带建立最大的颜色关系，一处明黄强调和集中的黑形体点破它。圆润剪影和少数小弯笔承载表情；线条粗细轻微变化，不像机械等宽。细小抓纸填充聚在暗区，大多数表面保持敞开而不塑形。一道低位水平分界承托紧凑的两形组合，上方留下宽阔安静色场。均匀光只形成小小的落地影，因此图像靠轮廓、间距与色彩而非戏剧体积来阅读。轻微颜料斑驳和不完美墨边保留实体印刷感。布局直接而幽默，主要形状间有清楚负空间，形成轻松的左右交流节奏。每个可见细节都在画格简明的视觉语法中发挥作用。
theme_en: A solemn child and a smiling dog in a simple comic panel
theme_zh: 简洁漫画画格中的严肃孩子与微笑小狗
name: Charles Schulz
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
